name: Berlin Group NextGenPSD2
description: NextGenPSD2 — pan-European PSD2 API and security specification. The most-implemented European Open Banking standard alongside UK OBIE.

license.notes: Mostly free; some implementation material members-only. Publicly accessible web resource with no login required (Tier 2 of Kurt Seifried 2026-11-09 4-tier hosting rule: open-web no-login content is mirrored in the public dataset repository with attribution).
